Name: Harvest Valley Music Add-on
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I like having more music in my game, and I've been a fan of the Harvest Moon series all my life. So I thought, why not combine them?

This mod adds a bunch of tracks from various Harvest Moon games as new seasonal tracks that will rotate with the in-game music. You can also play them on the jukebox at the Saloon!

Usual install instructions, just download, drag and drop into your mod folder.

Enjoy!
